mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM vaccine_info
AND vaccine_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{vaccineName}, '%')
AND FIND_IN_SET(#{breedId}, breed_ids)
AND manufacturer LIKE CONCAT('%', #{manufacturer}, '%')

SELECT
FROM vaccine_info vi
AND vi.vaccine_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{vaccineName}, '%')
AND FIND_IN_SET(#{breedId}, vi.breed_ids)
AND vi.manufacturer LIKE CONCAT('%', #{manufacturer}, '%')
AND ( vi.vaccine_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{vaccineNameSearch}, '%') OR vi.vaccine_short LIKE CONCAT('%', #{vaccineNameSearch}, '%') )
ORDER BY ${custom_order_by}

SELECT
FROM vaccine_info vi WHERE FIND_IN_SET(#{breedId}, vi.breed_ids) ORDER BY vi.vaccine_name ASC

SELECT vi.*,
CASE WHEN COUNT(pr.record_id) = 0 THEN '未接种' WHEN COUNT(pr.record_id) < CAST(vi.injection_times AS UNSIGNED) THEN '未完成' WHEN COUNT(pr.record_id) >= CAST(vi.injection_times AS UNSIGNED) AND vi.enhance_days IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), MAX(pr.injection_date)) >= vi.enhance_days THEN '需加强针' END AS suggest_type,
CASE WHEN COUNT(pr.record_id) = 0 THEN CURDATE() WHEN COUNT(pr.record_id) < CAST(vi.injection_times AS UNSIGNED) THEN DATE_ADD(MAX(pr.injection_date), INTERVAL vi.interval_days DAY) WHEN COUNT(pr.record_id) >= CAST(vi.injection_times AS UNSIGNED) AND vi.enhance_days IS NOT NULL THEN DATE_ADD(MAX(pr.injection_date), INTERVAL vi.enhance_days DAY) END AS next_injection_date, -- 是否已预约 CASE WHEN COUNT(pe.event_id) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_appointment,
MAX(pr.injection_date) as last_injection_date
FROM vaccine_info vi LEFT JOIN pet_vaccine_record pr ON vi.vaccine_id = pr.vaccine_id AND pr.pet_id = #{petId}
LEFT JOIN pet_event pe ON pe.pet_id = #{petId} AND pe.event_type = 1 AND pe.status = 0 AND pe.event_content LIKE CONCAT('%', vi.vaccine_name, '%')
WHERE FIND_IN_SET(#{breedId}, vi.breed_ids)
GROUP BY vi.vaccine_id
HAVING ( COUNT(pr.record_id) = 0 OR COUNT(pr.record_id) < CAST(vi.injection_times AS UNSIGNED) OR ( COUNT(pr.record_id) >= CAST(vi.injection_times AS UNSIGNED) AND vi.enhance_days IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), MAX(pr.injection_date)) >= vi.enhance_days ) ) -- 只要未预约的 AND COUNT(pe.event_id) = 0

SELECT vi.vaccine_id, vi.vaccine_name, CAST(vi.injection_times AS UNSIGNED) AS required_times, IFNULL(COUNT(pr.record_id), 0) AS actual_times, CASE WHEN COUNT(pr.record_id) >= CAST(vi.injection_times AS UNSIGNED) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_completed, CASE WHEN COUNT(pr.record_id) >= CAST(vi.injection_times AS UNSIGNED) THEN 0 ELSE CAST(vi.injection_times AS UNSIGNED) - COUNT(pr.record_id) END AS missing_times FROM vaccine_info vi LEFT JOIN pet_vaccine_record pr ON vi.vaccine_id = pr.vaccine_id AND pr.pet_id = #{petId} WHERE FIND_IN_SET(#{breedId}, vi.breed_ids) GROUP BY vi.vaccine_id
